useEffect.description: Three separate components each make their own request

reactQuery.description: Automatic request deduplication - single request for multiple components

swr.description: Automatic deduplication within dedupingInterval (2 seconds by default)

useEffect.description: Manual implementation required - no automatic refetch on window focus

reactQuery.description: Built-in automatic refetch when window regains focus (configurable via refetchOnWindowFocus)

swr.description: Built-in automatic refetch on window focus (default behavior)

useEffect.description: Manual implementation required for retry logic

reactQuery.description: Automatic retry with 3 attempts and exponential backoff

swr.description: Automatic retry with exponential backoff strategy

useEffect.description: Manual implementation - must update state before request and rollback on error

reactQuery.description: Built-in with automatic rollback support through mutation lifecycle

swr.description: Limited support - requires manual implementation with mutate function

secondVisitLoadTimeMs.description: Time to display data when returning to page. useEffect refetches; Query/SWR serve from cache

useEffect.description: No caching - data lost on component unmount

reactQuery.description: Automatic caching with configurable freshness window

componentReRenders.useEffect: Unoptimized - every state change triggers render
componentReRenders.reactQuery: Optimized - query batching and selective updates

userExperienceLag.useEffect: Visible - must wait for full refetch cycle

summary.recommendation: Use React Query for production applications, SWR for lightweight projects, useEffect only for learning
summary.migrationPath: useEffect -> SWR (if lightweight) or useEffect -> React Query (if feature-rich)
summary.performanceGain: 80-90% reduction in network requests, 50-70% reduction in load time on repeat visits
